correctness.rationale: Before the last car parks in vacancy k+1, previous cars split into k left and r=n−1−k right valid parking lists; signed binary interleaving sum is Gaussian binomial at q=−1, zero for even m/odd k and binom(floor m/2,floor k/2) otherwise. The last car contributes (k+1)(−1)^r. This yields exact recurrence; separating even/odd EGF gives O=(zE²)′ and E′=E³+8zE²E′+4z²E²E″. Coefficient of z^m on RHS uses only prior E coefficients with nonnegative weights, while E³ strictly positive, inductively D_{2m}>0, then O positivity yields D_{2m+1}>0. The n=1 base and D0 empty convention addressed. Independent direct brute-force preference enumeration n≤5 and signed recurrence through n≤15 reproduced values D1..D8=1,1,4,11,72,335,2944,19449. No convergence of EGF needed (formal only).

value.rationale: The final outcome-permutation sign is a fundamental but nonuniform statistic of random classical parking. A universal strict even bias (not obvious from pointwise probability weights), an exact quadratic-arithmetic recurrence and a positive formal differential mechanism form a mathematically motivated and reusable parity theorem. Different preference-word inversions are explicitly excluded.
